name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Use Stim to generate a distance-3 repetition
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Use Stim to generate a distance-3 repetition code memory experiment (15 rounds, depolarizing noise 0.03), decode with PyMatching, and print the logical error rate over 20000 shots. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
